### basic_audio
v=0
o=- 20518 0 IN IP4 198.51.100.1
s=CallScope Test
c=IN IP4 198.51.100.1
t=0 0
m=audio 30000 RTP/AVP 0 8 101
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-15
a=sendrecv
a=label:1

### explicit_rtcp
v=0
o=- 1 1 IN IP4 203.0.113.5
s=-
c=IN IP4 203.0.113.5
t=0 0
m=audio 40000 RTP/AVP 0
a=rtcp:40002
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=sendonly
a=label:2

### rtcp_mux
v=0
o=- 2 2 IN IP4 203.0.113.6
s=-
t=0 0
m=audio 50000 RTP/AVP 0
c=IN IP4 203.0.113.6
a=rtcp-mux
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=recvonly
a=mid:audio1

### inactive_hold
v=0
o=- 3 3 IN IP4 203.0.113.7
s=-
c=IN IP4 203.0.113.7
t=0 0
m=audio 30000 RTP/AVP 0
a=inactive
a=label:1

### multi_media
v=0
o=- 4 4 IN IP4 203.0.113.8
s=-
c=IN IP4 203.0.113.8
t=0 0
m=audio 30000 RTP/AVP 0 8
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=label:1
a=sendrecv
m=video 30002 RTP/AVP 96
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=label:2
a=sendrecv

### media_level_connection

s=-
t=0 0
m=audio 30000 RTP/AVP 0
c=IN IP4 198.51.100.50
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
